# CG-RES-023: Response header became optional

A required response header is now optional.

**Why it matters:** A guaranteed header may now be absent.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Detects | `header.requiredChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Header is no longer guaranteed: {where}.
>
> Consumers that read the header without checking for absence may fail.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the header required, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: header became optional

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {X-A: {required: true, schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {X-A: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Header is no longer guaranteed: GET /x: header "x-a" of response 200.

### Does not fire: header became required

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {X-A: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, headers: {X-A: {required: true, schema: {type: string}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
